body:
325 Northfield Dr E (Z-25-18)
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners, other agencies and city council before anything can be built.
325 Northfield Dr Inc and MHBC Planning are proposing to permit three new employment uses within the previously approved development.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
to permit 'Light' Pharmaceutical Industry, 'Light' Laboratory, and Small Scale Warehouse uses
to include previously approved parking and impervious coverage reductions within the proposed site-specific zoning
Please note: The buildings shown in this application have already been approved through the Site Plan Review Committee. This application is to permit new employment uses within the previously approved buildings.
View the documents submitted by the development company under 'supporting documents' for more details and drawings.
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the delegated staff authority, or ask a question below to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.

Do not include personal or identifying information in your question; if your question is of a personal nature, consider contacting a member of the project team directly. For more information, please refer to our privacy policy.
Questions will be answered by a member of the Planning department within two business days. Some questions may require more time but they will be answered as soon as the information for the response can be collected.
